//: mirbadllm-hostd seed config on a Mac (Phase 4; plan docs/macos/implementation-plan.md M10). install-agent.sh install-hostd installs it as "/Library/Application Support/mirbadllm-hostd/hostd.json" (root:wheel 0644) only when the file does not exist yet, with discoverUsers set to the account that ran sudo (or each --discover-user). The agent cannot change it. Units are launchd labels: scope "system" is a LaunchDaemon in /Library/LaunchDaemons, scope "user" a LaunchAgent of one of discoverUsers (~/Library/LaunchAgents or /Library/LaunchAgents), loaded in that user's gui/<uid> session. On first start these entries seed the admin-managed whitelist in state/whitelist.json (root, 0600); entries added here later are merged into it once. After that the Services page adds and removes jobs (admin password required). The list starts empty: Discovered on the Services page shows every job with a plist, e.g. homebrew.mxcl.ollama for Ollama installed with Homebrew. Jobs matching the compiled-in deny list (com.apple.*, com.mirbadllm.*, actions.runner.* (the GitHub runners), com.docker.*, SSH, cron, time) or hostd-deny.json next to this file ({"patterns": ["foo.*"]}, root-owned) can never be managed. socketGroup: the group that may use the socket (the agent's). Restart hostd after editing: sudo launchctl kickstart -k system/com.mirbadllm.hostd
